criteria.1.1: WHEN a shopper buys a Gift_Card with a value of 10–500 dollars, THE Shop_API SHALL charge the Payment_Provider and create an `active` Gift_Card with that balance.
criteria.1.2: WHEN a Gift_Card is created, THE Shop_API SHALL return its 16-character code.
criteria.1.3: IF the Payment_Provider charge fails, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return HTTP 402 with error `payment_failed` and create no Gift_Card.
criteria.2.1: WHEN a shopper applies an `active` Gift_Card code to a Cart, THE Shop_API SHALL subtract the Cart subtotal from the Gift_Card balance.
criteria.2.2: THE Shop_API SHALL return the redemption response within 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
criteria.2.3: IF the code does not match any Gift_Card, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return HTTP 404 with error `unknown_card`.
criteria.2.4: IF the Cart subtotal exceeds the Gift_Card balance, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL reject the redemption with HTTP 422 and error `insufficient_balance`, leaving the balance unchanged.
criteria.2.5: WHEN two redemptions of one Gift_Card run at the same time, THE Shop_API SHALL apply them one after the other so the final balance is never below 0 cents.
criteria.3.1: WHEN an Actor with role `staff` sends `POST /gift-cards/<code>/void`, THE Shop_API SHALL set the Gift_Card status to `void`.
criteria.3.2: WHILE a Gift_Card is `void`, THE Shop_API SHALL reject redemption with HTTP 409 and error `card_void`.
criteria.3.3: IF a void request comes from an Actor whose role is not `staff`, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return HTTP 403 with error `forbidden` and leave the Gift_Card status unchanged.
criteria.3.4: IF a redemption request targets a `void` Gift_Card, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return HTTP 409 with error `card_void` before any balance check, even when the Cart subtotal exceeds the balance.
criteria.4.1: THE Shop_API SHALL keep Gift_Card balances forever; Gift_Cards never expire.
criteria.4.2: WHEN a Gift_Card is unused for 12 months, THE Shop_API SHALL keep its status `active`.
criteria.5.1: WHEN a Gift_Card balance or status changes, THE Shop_API SHALL append a ledger entry with the code, old value, new value, actor id, and UTC timestamp.
criteria.5.2: IF the ledger write fails, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL reject the change with HTTP 503 and error `ledger_unavailable`.
criteria.5.3: IF the ledger write fails during gift card purchase after a successful charge, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL refund the charge through the Payment_Provider and create no Gift_Card.
